pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Gentoo network backend adapter for Proxmox VE.
Provides /usr/sbin/pve-ifreload — a drop-in replacement for ifupdown2's "ifreload -a" which Proxmox uses to apply network configuration changes.
On Gentoo, /etc/network/interfaces is maintained by PVE as its source of truth for network configuration (read/displayed in the web UI, written when you save changes). pve-ifreload translates this file to your active Gentoo network backend: systemd-networkd (.network/.netdev files), NetworkManager (nmcli), or netifrc (/etc/conf.d/net.pve).
Also carries the pve-manager patch that makes ifreload calls conditional on the available tool (pve-ifreload on Gentoo, ifreload on Debian).
